scope: Private, frozen full-connectome numerical efficacy fitting on recorded RGB; no live Doom skill or biological learning established.

rule.interpretation: Centered rate-rule adaptation on existing individual edges, not an exact reproduction of the published nine-unit model. Equal trace constants, efficacy bounds, gain and 50 ms weight filter require calibration.

data_selection: First mechanically selected new indices after historical 0/1; source/control schema and publisher metadata inspected before probes. Held outputs not used for updates; not fully blinded.

collector.angular_mapping: Repository conversion; publisher angular calibration was not independently established.

protocol.objective: Equal mean of two complete episodes: equal class-mean absolute turn error; 0.1 degree dead zone.
protocol.acceptance: Strict lower complete training-bank loss; ties retain incumbent.
protocol.endogenous_DAN_activity: May be nonzero; this is distinct from zero external reinforcement.
protocol.random_controls: Independent uniform static vectors, no training score or selection, held only and unequal compute.

held_selection: None; all four terminal fitted vectors and both predeclared random controls reported.
uncertainty: Two episodes and two fitting replicas per method; frames/contiguous blocks are dependent diagnostics, not independent uncertainty samples.

native_logger.scope: Terminal-hash small CPU/real four-lane Metal fixtures only; numerical, not biological validation.
native_logger.wall_scope: Validation envelope: pressure/test execution and post-test physical pin audit; distinct from pytest duration.

ordinary_full_native.scope: Ordinary full native test suite; numerical contracts, no scientific study replay or biological validation.
ordinary_full_native.wall_scope: Validation envelope: pressure/test execution and post-test physical pin audit; distinct from pytest duration.

validation.logging_limit: Original JSON hashed host native arrays before device materialization. Preserve JSON/checkpoints; corrected-source native fixtures do not retroactively validate original hashes.

timing.scope: Batch advance is shared host+native work, not GPU-only or end-to-end. Replay includes setup/warmup/RGB/checkpoint writes. Allocation-to-release pressure interval excludes preflight/final audit/SSH. No clean whole-command stopwatch or CPU comparison.

resources.raw_storage: Durable ignored private experiment storage; checkpoints are not bundled.

software_observed_during_run_not_before_.scope: Installed interpreter/package observation during immutable fixed study; not a pre-probe capture.

preserved_failures_controls: Original CLI c50b5be preflight exit1 before allocation/output/attempts; source-clean guard corrected.
Failed acquisition and logger RED logs preserved.
